title: Drinking Party
text: Meanwhile, the visiting nobles seemed to still be chatting away in the guest quarters of the castle.
“It might just be a Siltvelt thing, but… the locals are still out and about even at night. Seems like the nobles are still awake too.”
Father said this while checking the range of what he could see from the terrace on the castle’s upper floor.
“Well, if anything, a lot of folks around here are more night owls.”
“It does seem to be a racial thing as well.”
“I’m going to bed.”
“Feels like Lars-chan’s been sleeping too much.”
Panda had been resting nonstop ever since we got here, I say.
“Ohh? Want me to keep you company for a bit?”
Guess there’s no helping it… Panda let out a deep sigh at Father.
“That’s not what I meant. Never mind. Guess it’s just the nature of a country with so many different races—things don’t really quiet down at night.”
Father, who had already surrendered his body to Rival, spoke of Siltvelt’s nights in just that way, I say.
“Woof? If you want it quiet, I could use my authority as lord and order everyone to sleep—want me to?”
“It’s not that big a deal, so it’s fine.”
“Woof, then how about we sleep together in my room?”
Wolf wagged his tail, still wearing his bathrobe.
“You’re clearly just dying to do that, aren’t you—”
Even Father furrowed his brow, looking troubled.
“Do you really want me to sleep beside you that badly? Well, I have done it before when you were whining out of your mind, but still.”
Back before Wolf could even speak, there had been times when Father soothed him until he fell asleep.
“Woof?”
Wolf seemed to be thinking something over.
“Woooof!”
Then he nodded deeply.
“What are you nodding for? That’s definitely not it, Iwatani-sama.”
“Exactly. No need to spoil him.”
Rabbit Guy and Crocodile Guy cautioned.
“Well, sleeping with everyone in one big bed does sound kind of fun, like a school trip.”
“Grrr… Woooof! That works! Everyone sleeps together! We drink through the night! And I’ll sip wine while watching everyone sleep! Awooo!”
Wolf, who’d seemed to be growling a moment ago, apparently made up his mind and declared it flat out.
“Whoa, he actually compromised.”
“No, he’s planning to drink everyone else under the table! He means to see it through after that!”
“Awooo! The night’s only just beginning! Bring the booze, woof!”
At Wolf’s shout and clapping, the servants ended up bringing in barrels and bottles of liquor. They kept hauling more and more into the room where Father was supposed to sleep.
“The feast begins here, woof! We drink the night away with close friends, woof!”
“Wow… if Sadeena-san were here, she’d be thrilled about this.”
“What about Elmelo, though? He can’t make it all the way here, can he?”
“We’ll do it with just the people here, woof! Or are you two lightweights, woof?”
Wolf smirked as he said it, provoking Rabbit Guy and Crocodile Guy.
“Ngh… there’s no need to indulge him.”
“Hmph, coward, woof.”
“What did you say? Fine, I’ll do it.”
Rabbit Guy showed he was fired up by Wolf’s provocation, I say. He had surprisingly hot blood, indeed.
“Hey…”
“If we don’t show who’s strongest here, he’ll act smug about it every time something comes up. We can’t back down.”
“…I see. Guess it really is about time we settled who’s number one.”
“Hold on, what’s gotten into everyone? Are you all just letting loose because Sadeena-san isn’t around?”
Rabbit Guy smiled at Father’s question.
“You don’t need to worry about it, Iwatani-sama. I just figured it’d be good to find out where our limits actually are. We can’t really do this kind of thing with her around.”
“Is that so? Shion, are you on board with this too?”
“Ah, sort of. Well, it’s Wolf’s treat, so it’s a good opportunity. You just go ahead and drink slowly with Larsazusa.”
“The trouble is, I’ll probably end up being the one nursing everyone afterward…”
Father tilted his head, thinking the whole atmosphere felt a bit like being back at a college drinking party.
“Heh… I’ll be fine.”
“Well, when it comes to drinking, I intend to enjoy myself too.”
“S-so, Motoyasu-kun, what about you?”
“Me, you say?”
“What, you’re not drinking, woof?”
Wolf spoke with a tone of confidence.
Hmph, does he really think someone like him could beat me? I may lose when Older Sister or Panda get serious, but I can hold my liquor too!
“I’ll take you on, indeed. Tremble before my strength.”
“Was Motoyasu-kun ever actually that strong at this? I feel like he just doesn’t drink enough to pass out…”
I could hear Father saying something like that, but I was joining the drinking contest regardless.
“Motoyasu-sama! Please do your best!”
“I shall, indeed!”
“Once he’s passed out, I’ll hand him over to you, so feel free to do as you like with him~”
Rabbit Guy said this to Yuki-chan with a smirk. What in the world was he talking about?
“M-my support for him won’t change! Motoyasu-sama! Please keep drinking and show us how strong you are!”

With Yuki-chan’s cheering behind me, I was suddenly all fired up. But why did this feel so familiar? Almost like I’d been through this exact exchange before in some previous loop, getting beaten by Older Sister or Panda while Yuki-chan cheered me on… Surely it was just my imagination. Yuki-chan was cheering for me with pure intentions, indeed.
“I shall do it, indeed!”
And so, a drinking contest was held among everyone in the room.
“Glug, glug… haah, this one’s got quite a kick.”

First up was a drink similar to ale. Incidentally, when it came to the temperature of drinks, this world had a custom—passed down through the Heroes—of serving whichever drinks tasted better cold chilled, and whichever tasted better warm heated up. So the ale-like drink was served chilled.
“This one’s a fruit-based drink.”
“Ah, that’s from fruit grown around here. Isn’t it the same fruit they make wine from?”
“Correct, awooo!”

Wolf downed it in one go, gulp after gulp. He seemed to be daring us with a “Come on, catch up!” attitude, so the rest of us followed suit. The servants brought out a blackboard from somewhere and started keeping count of how many cups everyone drank. Cup after cup, two, then three, kept getting poured.

Amid all this, Father was drinking alongside Panda. Of course, given that Father could keep pace with Older Sister without issue, and could even eat Lucor fruit without a problem, he was already in a league of his own—basically disqualified from consideration, I say. Panda was also quite strong when it came to drinking, so she too was being left out of the actual competition.
“If it’s all the same flavor, I’ll get bored of it.”
“Then let’s try a different drink, woof.”
At Wolf’s command, wine was opened next and poured out. It was sweeter than the wine I knew. Overall, the drinks around here seemed to run on the sweet side.
“Here you go, Motoyasu-sama!”
Yuki-chan had taken on the role of pouring my drinks for me. Perhaps it was just my imagination, but Yuki-chan’s eyes seemed to be gleaming.
“This one goes down sweet.”
“Father, Father.”
“What is it? Motoyasu-kun, are you getting drunk?”
“I’m fine, indeed!”

I wasn’t drunk yet. There was no way I’d get plastered from something this mild. Since I couldn’t stand being drunk under the table by Older Sister forever, I’d unlocked a good number of tolerance-type skills, so I wasn’t about to lose easily.
“Father, you’re skilled at cooking, but how much do you actually know about drinks, I wonder?”
I felt like I might have asked this casually before, but I couldn’t quite remember, so I asked anyway.

“I don’t know that much, honestly. Well, I did work part-time at an izakaya and a bar before, so I guess I can make cocktails and things? There was a good manga about it for a while that I copied off of. The bartenders taught me a bunch of stuff too when I asked.”

Oh? That reminded me of something Itsuki once said: “Naofumi-san always claims he’s done some part-time job or another for everything, so he seems like he can do just about anything.” But apparently, manga had influenced him too. Even his incredible knife skills were supposedly copied from manga and anime. It brought back memories of a previous loop, back when Itsuki had grown into an adult and kept making all sorts of requests of Father.
